subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the CodeQL and create-github-app-token upgrades remain grouped with the other action bumps?
rationale: Those actions execute in security-scanning and credential-minting workflows owned by the secops team, so grouping and rollback scope require explicit owner intent even though the proposed commits match upstream release tags.

options.title: Keep the grouped update
options.body: Approve the verified immutable pins together after guard repair and green exact-head checks.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move CodeQL and app-token upgrades into a separate secops-reviewed PR for narrower rollback scope.

recommendation.title: Keep the grouped update
recommendation.body: Approve the verified immutable pins together after guard repair and green exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best individual routing candidate from workflow ownership history, while the security-specific CODEOWNERS entry names a team rather than an individual.
